tips:
1- OTP validation: 
 a. If this is a new beneficiary, OTP will be sent to mobile number registered on core for validation. 
 b. If existing beneficiary is selected, payment will be processed without OTP
2- Account selected from dashboard is the debit account number.
3- FX displayed in retrieved from bank’s list.
4- If cross currency transfer applied, actual amount and equivalent amounts will be displayed in preview / confirm screen.
5- SHA charges selected when charges transfer needs to be shared between issuer and beneficiary.
6- Our charges selected when transfer charges need to be issuer only.
